title.purpose: Page ledes/intros directly under a Display heading.

label.purpose: Button text and small uppercase UI labels.

shadows.name: ambient-hairline
shadows.purpose: Faintest possible seam under panels, cards and form fields — a texture, not a lift.

shadows.name: focus-ring
shadows.purpose: Focus-visible / selection glow — the only shadow use that is ever clearly visible.

motion.name: ease-entrance
motion.purpose: Default easing for scroll-reveal and card entrance animations.

motion.name: ease-overshoot
motion.purpose: Playful pop-in for checkbox/radio confirmation and cart-count bump.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The site's main call-to-action — petrol fill, hairline gold border, uppercase spaced label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; background: #123d43; color: #fbf9f5; border: 1px solid #b89a62; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.7rem 1.35rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 1.25; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #0e2e33; } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: #0b262a; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #123d43; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action — hairline border, deepens on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.6rem; background: #ffffff; color: #123d43; border: 1px solid #d9cdbb; border-radius: 6px; padding: 0.6rem 1.15rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.8rem; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: #123d43; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #123d43; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Shared look for every text/email/password input, select, and textarea.
components.css: .ds-field { width: 100%; border-radius: 0.75rem; border: 1.5px solid rgba(18, 61, 67, 0.16); background: #ffffff; padding: 0.65rem 0.95rem; color: #123d43; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 1rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 1px rgba(18, 61, 67, 0.04); transition: border-color 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease; } .ds-field::placeholder { color: rgba(18, 61, 67, 0.48); } .ds-field:hover:not(:disabled):not(:focus) { border-color: rgba(18, 61, 67, 0.5); } .ds-field:focus { outline: none; border-color: #123d43; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3.5px rgba(18, 61, 67, 0.2); }

components.name: Checkbox
components.description: Custom checkbox with an overshoot pop-in checkmark.
components.css: .ds-checkbox { appearance: none; -webkit-appearance: none; display: inline-grid; place-content: center; width: 1.3rem; height: 1.3rem; border-radius: 0.4rem; border: 1.5px solid rgba(18, 61, 67, 0.32); background: rgba(18, 61, 67, 0.03); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease; } .ds-checkbox::after { content: ''; width: 0.72rem; height: 0.72rem; background-color: white; clip-path: polygon(14% 44%, 0 65%, 50% 100%, 100% 16%, 80% 0%, 43% 62%); transform: scale(0); transition: transform 0.25s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1); } .ds-checkbox:checked { border-color: #123d43; background: #123d43; } .ds-checkbox:checked::after { transform: scale(1); } .ds-checkbox:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px rgba(18, 61, 67, 0.2); }

components.name: Panel Card
components.description: Standard translucent-ivory wrapper for forms and grouped content.
components.html:
Shipping address

123 Calle del Vetro, Venezia
components.css: .ds-card { border: 1px solid #d9cdbb; border-radius: 14px; background: #fbf9f5; padding: 1.25rem; } .ds-card-title { margin: 0 0 0.4rem; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 500; color: #123d43; } .ds-card-body { margin: 0; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.9rem; color: #527176; }

components.name: Filter Chip
components.description: Pill-shaped filter/category tag; fills solid petrol on hover.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 0.3rem 1rem; border: 1px solid #d9cdbb; border-radius: 999px; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.6); color: #123d43; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.92rem; text-decoration: none; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 0.15s ease, border-color 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-chip:hover { background: #123d43; border-color: #123d43; color: #fff; }

components.name: Product Tile
components.description: Signature component: the product photo dissolves into the ivory page (multiply blend), name and price sit directly below with no card border.
components.html: Rubino Necklace€128
components.css: .ds-tile { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.3rem; text-decoration: none; color: inherit; } .ds-tile-photo { position: relative; aspect-ratio: 2 / 3; overflow: hidden; } .ds-tile-photo img { width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; mix-blend-mode: multiply; filter: brightness(1.05) contrast(1.03); } .ds-tile-name { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.15rem; line-height: 1.25; color: #123d43; } .ds-tile-name:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: #123d43; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-tile-price { font-family: 'Cormorant Garamond', Georgia, serif; font-size: 1.15rem; font-weight: 500; color: #123d43; }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Header/footer text link with a scale-drawing underline and a soft pill hover background.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding: 0.3rem 0.1rem; color: #123d43; font-family: 'DM Sans', system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.95rem; text-decoration: none; transition: transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-nav-link::before { content: ''; position: absolute; inset: -0.2rem -0.55rem; z-index: -1; border-radius: 999px; background-color: rgba(18, 61, 67, 0.1); opacity: 0; transition: opacity 0.2s ease; } .ds-nav-link::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; bottom: -2px; height: 1px; width: 100%; background: currentColor; transform: scaleX(0); transform-origin: right; transition: transform 0.25s ease; } .ds-nav-link:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-nav-link:hover::before { opacity: 1; } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform: scaleX(1); transform-origin: left; }

narrative.overview:
The site reads as a hand-bound ledger documenting each piece rather than a typical retail shelf: near-white ivory pages, a single deep petrol ink for type and interaction, and a hairline of champagne gold as the only ornament. The glass itself — teal, rose, gold — supplies the sole bursts of saturated color, in photographs and in one decorative rule at the header/footer edge; everything else stays deliberately quiet so those pieces read as precious.

The overall philosophy is luxe, gallery-cool, and minimal: flat surfaces separated by hairline borders rather than shadows, a serif display face (Cormorant Garamond) for headings, prices and product names against a plain sans (DM Sans) for every interactive and body surface, and motion kept to a handful of small, purposeful moments (a settling hero bead, a cart bounce, a confetti burst) rather than pervasive hover choreography.
keyCharacteristics: Ivory paper + Deep Lagoon Petrol ink, with Champagne Gold as the only ornamental accent
Flat by default — hairline borders and tonal panels carry separation, not shadows
Cormorant Garamond (display/serif) paired with DM Sans (UI/sans), strict role separation
The product photograph is the only saturated color on most screens
Motion is sparse and purposeful, never ambient or decorative-only

rules.name: The One Ornament Rule
rules.body: Champagne Gold appears only as a hairline, rule, or border — never as a fill, a large shape, or body text. Its rarity is what makes it read as precious rather than decorative.

rules.name: The Glass Supplies the Color Rule
rules.body: Glass Teal/Rose/Gold exist to echo the product photography, not to color UI chrome. If a control needs an accent color, it's petrol or gold — never a glass tone.

rules.name: The Role-Locked Face Rule
rules.body: Cormorant Garamond is reserved for headings, product names, prices, and the empty-state signature line. DM Sans owns every button, nav item, form field, and label. A component never borrows the other face for emphasis.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: Nothing gets a visible drop shadow to signal "this is a card." Borders and fill contrast do that job; shadow is reserved for focus rings and the faintest ambient seam.

dos: Do keep Champagne Gold to hairlines, rules, and borders — treat any gold fill or large gold shape as a violation of the One Ornament Rule.
Do let product photography be the only saturated color on a page; keep UI chrome to petrol, gold, and ivory/white.
Do separate panels from background with a hairline border and a one-shade fill shift, not a shadow.
Do keep Cormorant Garamond strictly to headings/names/prices and DM Sans to every interactive/UI surface.
Do respect prefers-reduced-motion: all auto-playing entrance/ambient animation must collapse to instant; interaction-triggered feedback (hover lifts, underline draws) may remain.
donts: Don't add a visible drop shadow to signal elevation — this system uses borders and fill contrast, never a "lifted card" look.
Don't use Glass Teal/Rose/Gold on buttons, links, or any interactive control — those three exist only to echo the product photo in decorative, non-interactive contexts.
Don't imply the protected "Vetro Artistico® Murano" certification mark in copy or badges unless the specific product actually holds it (durable product constraint, not a visual one — see PRODUCT.md).
Don't mix Cormorant Garamond into body copy or DM Sans into headings — the two faces are role-locked, not interchangeable for emphasis.
